jobs.occupation: QA Specialist, QA Commercial Drug Substance
jobs.description:
Are you experienced in managing CMO collaborations and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders? Do you thrive in a broad QA role where you combine your GMP expertise with a pragmatic and hands-on approach across different quality areas?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new QA Specialist in QA Commercial Operations.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate QA specialist to join our team. You will be a part of the well-functioning QA Drug Substance/QA for QC team in the QA Commercial Operations department, with responsibility for quality oversight of starting materials, intermediates, and Drug Substances for commercial products. We have a close collaboration with our Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and process- and QC SMEs internally at Ascendis Pharma.

Your key responsibilities will be:

As part of the role, you will work broadly across quality oversight activities and take ownership of a wide range of tasks and responsibilities, including:

• Take primary responsibility for oversight of one or more CMOs in our supply chains with respect to review and approval of documentation from these CMOs, including upscale activities, PPQ documentation, CPVs, batch documentation, deviations, changes, CAPAs, stability studies, QMRs, quality agreements etc

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key CMO stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and effective collaboration through meetings, teleconferences, and audits. Participate in CMO evaluations and product quality reviews

• Keep up to date with changes in relevant product guidelines and regulatory requirements and ensure cGMP at Ascendis and CMOs

• Drive and assume responsibility for agreed tasks and matters

• Continuously optimize our work processes and the way we execute quality oversight

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a master's degree in pharmacy or equivalent - and 5-10 years of experience within chemical and/or biological GMP production

Furthermore, you have:

• Solid QA experience, preferably including QA for QC, and experience working with CMOs

• Strong analytical skills, a collaborative mindset, and a can-do attitude

• Cultural understanding

• Experience with audits/inspections

• A critical and pragmatic mindset and yet with attention to the necessary details

• Clear and persistent communication skills, particular regarding expectations and requirements to quality

• Cooperative and striving for smooth cooperation with many stakeholders

• Ambitious and able to see the benefits in going the extra mile

The position as QA specialist requires experience with and knowledge of US and EU GMP regulations and requirements. Furthermore, you should be proficient in English at a professional level, both written and spoken, and you master MS Office.

At Ascendis Pharma, you will be part of a stimulating, informal, and innovative working environment, where you will interact with very skilled colleagues and partners to deliver on Ascendis' ambitious corporate goals. You will be part of an expanding QA-organization overseeing development, clinical, and commercial activities.

Travel: 5-20 days/year.

Place of work: Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the job or the company, please contact QA Senior Director, Jan Jakobsgaard, M +45 25 66 29 42 leave a message if call is not answered. All applications must be submitted in English and are treated confidentially.

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

_Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for an AI Business Manager to join our Digital Development team.

_**Team

**The AI team is a cross-functional team dedicated to embedding AI directly into CIP's business lifecycles and day-to-day operations across the platform and sits within the wider Digital Development team.

**Role

**The AI Business Manager is responsible for ensuring AI creates measurable business value across CIP's business lifecycles and works directly with lifecycle owners, product teams, delivery teams, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and embed AI capabilities into day-to-day processes and ways of working.

The AI Business Manager serves as the bridge between business priorities and AI capabilities, ensuring that AI is integrated directly into the Investor, Investment, Fund & Investment Management, and Project lifecycles rather than delivered as standalone technology initiatives. The role is accountable for helping lifecycle teams identify where AI can accelerate outcomes, improve decision-making, increase productivity, and enhance user experiences while ensuring appropriate governance and value realization.

**Responsibilities will consist of, but are not limited to:

**Lifecycle Partnership and Business Engagement

• Partner with lifecycle owners and business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives, identifying where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency, and decision quality.

• Participate in lifecycle planning and roadmap discussions to embed AI initiatives into business plans from the outset, acting as the primary AI partner for assigned lifecycle domains.

AI Opportunity and Use Case Management

• Facilitate identification, assessment, and prioritization of AI use cases, maintaining the opportunity pipeline based on business value, feasibility, and strategic alignment.

• Develop business cases, value hypotheses, and success metrics, supporting initiatives from ideation and validation through deployment and value realization.

Embedding AI into Business Lifecycles

• Work with business and technology teams to integrate AI into core processes, products, and workflows, redesigning ways of working where relevant and driving adoption of AI-powered tools.

• Support the evolution of lifecycle operating models to treat AI as a native capability, scaling effective patterns across domains.

Governance and Responsible AI

• Ensure AI initiatives comply with governance, security, risk, privacy, and regulatory requirements, coordinating with legal, risk, compliance, and information security stakeholders as needed.

• Support lifecycle teams in navigating AI policies and approval processes, promoting responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

Value Realization and Performance Management

• Track KPIs for AI adoption, utilization, and business value, measuring realized benefits such as productivity gains, cost savings, and risk reduction.

• Provide regular updates to leadership on AI portfolio performance and lifecycle impact.

Change, Communication, and Enablement

• Manage efforts for stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management for AI initiatives, supporting training and capability-building across lifecycle teams.

• Build and maintain networks of AI champions and subject matter experts, promoting a culture of experimentation and responsible AI usage.

**You

**You have a relevant educational background within business, data science, technology, or a similar field. In addition, you have a good understanding of business processes, operating models, and digital transformation, and 5+ years of experience working with technology transformation, AI, data, automation, or similar initiatives, with the ability to translate business challenges into practical AI opportunities and outcomes.

We look for the following in a candidate:

• Good stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable translating between business and technology audiences to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical business value.

• Experience driving change, adoption, and organizational enablement initiatives.

• Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Curious, business-oriented, and outcome-focused.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution and is motivated by delivering measurable impact through technology-enabled change.

**The process

**Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.

As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.

A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. **CIP Fund Solutions

**CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.

RESOLVA is assisting INVISIO with the recruitment of a Corporate Legal Counsel.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

INVISIO is looking for a commercially minded and pragmatic Corporate Legal Counsel to support its global business. This is a broad legal generalist role with a strong commercial focus, where you will work closely with the business and provide legal support across a wide range of matters, with particular emphasis on international contracts, tenders, customer projects and other commercial legal matters.

As Corporate Legal Counsel, you will become part of a small legal team together with Signe Karstoft, Legal Director, to whom you will report. The role is based at INVISIO’s headquarters in Hvidovre, and the legal function is organisationally anchored within INVISIO’s Sales & Program function, which consists of approximately 50 employees globally, including around 25-30 in Denmark. You will primarily support the global sales organisation and work closely with colleagues across the business. Much of your work will involve large and complex customer contracts, tenders and projects.

You will provide legal support across INVISIO’s international business, including in relation to US contracts, such as contracts within the defence sector, and support sales teams across Europe and other markets. You will also support INVISIO in connection with major public tenders, including tenders involving ministries and defence organisations, providing legal support on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

As a technology company, intellectual property is an important part of INVISIO’s business. While dedicated specialists handle areas such as patents, you may also advise on IP-related matters as part of the broader commercial legal support. Experience with IP or from a technology or other IP-intensive business would therefore be an advantage.

In addition to the day-to-day legal support, you will contribute to developing and improving the way Legal supports the business. This includes driving legal improvement initiatives, maintaining and developing contract templates and legal guidelines, and conducting workshops and awareness activities for the business.

The role is highly international and outward-facing, with significant interaction with customers and stakeholders at all levels. You will have opportunities to join customer visits and negotiate contracts abroad, as well as participate in trade fairs in Denmark, Europe and the US.

The role is expected to involve approximately 25 travel days per year.

As INVISIO continues to grow rapidly, you will work in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and no two days are the same.

AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

INVISIO is looking for an independent and commercially minded lawyer who takes ownership and enjoys working closely with customers and colleagues across the organisation. Your key responsibilities will include:

Commercial contracts and negotiations:

• 
Draft, review and negotiate a broad range of commercial contracts, including large international sales contracts, non-disclosure agreements, letters of intent, consulting agreements, tender-related contracts and distribution agreements.

• 
Take an active role in customer dialogue and contract negotiations and provide commercially focused legal advice, working closely with relevant stakeholders to balance legal considerations with commercial objectives.

• 
Provide pragmatic legal advice on contractual and other commercial matters arising in the day-to-day business.

Tenders and customer projects:

• 
Provide legal support in connection with major public tenders, including reviewing tender documentation and advising on contractual and other legal questions arising throughout the tender process.

• 
Advise on legal and contractual aspects of tender structures, including which INVISIO entity should participate and any related intercompany arrangements.

• 
Support and, where relevant, take a coordinating role in customer projects and other commercial initiatives, including advising on contractual set-ups, priorities and how existing solutions can be applied in different markets etc.

IP and export control:

• Ad hoc Advise on IP and export control matters, including IP considerations in commercial agreements and questions relating to export restrictions and requirements in connection with international sales and customer projects.

Legal development and business support:

• 
Develop, maintain and improve contract templates, legal guidelines and other tools.

• 
Drive legal improvement initiatives and conduct workshops and legal awareness activities for the business, for example in relation to NDA’s.

• 
Provide ad hoc legal advice and support across INVISIO as required.

REPORTING AND TITLE

Reporting to: Signe Karstoft, Legal Director.

Title: Corporate Legal Counsel.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE

Education: You hold a master’s degree in law (cand.jur. or cand.merc.jur).

Work experience: You have approximately 3-6 years of relevant legal experience from an in-house role, for example in a technology or software company or another larger international industrial company.

Legal areas of specialisation: You have strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial agreements and are comfortable handling contractual matters independently. You also have experience supporting tender processes and advising on the legal and contractual matters that arise in this context.

In addition, you have a broad legal profile and are able to navigate a varied range of legal matters. Experience with IP-related matters, particularly from a technology or other IP-intensive business, would be an advantage. Knowledge of export control would also be beneficial.

We are looking for a hands-on pharmacometrician who combines scientific excellence with strategic thinking and wants broad ownership across programs.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

Our Pharmacometrics Department supports every asset in the Ascendis portfolio and acts as a strategic partner throughout development, from innovation and early research through translational and clinical development, regulatory submissions, and life cycle management. Each pharmacometrician contributes directly to development strategy and portfolio decisions.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on Specialist/Senior Specialist Pharmacometrician who can address complex development questions and translate quantitative insights into actionable recommendations. You will apply model-informed drug development in rare diseases, where quantitative methods can directly inform trial design, dose selection, and evidence generation in small patient populations. You will gain exposure across translational and development stages and contribute to projects throughout the portfolio, providing broad visibility and influence within the company.

This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results. You will work both independently and in close collaboration with colleagues in Pharmacometrics, global project teams, external partners, and consultants. You will be joining the growing Pharmacometrics Department and report directly to Kristin Carlsson Petri, Senior Director and Head of Pharmacometrics, who is based in Hellerup. • Develop model-informed drug development strategies for translational and clinical-stage projects and ensure optimal use of pharmacometric methods to inform trial and program design

• Shape regulatory strategy and represent pharmacometrics in global health authority interactions

• Inform dose selection, trial design, regulatory strategy, and lifecycle decisions through population PK/PD modeling, simulation, exposure-response analysis, and quantitative benefit-risk assessment

• Translate quantitative results into clear recommendations to project teams, senior management, health authorities, external partners or organizations

• Plan, document and report pharmacometric analyses in accordance with internal quality standards and global regulatory submission requirements

• Strengthen departmental methods, standards and capabilities through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and continued development of the department's modeling and reporting environment

You hold a PhD, MSc, or equivalent qualification in pharmacometrics, pharmaceutical sciences, pharmacokinetics, mathematics, engineering, or another relevant quantitative discipline. You have relevant experience with PK/PD modeling and model-informed drug development.

Furthermore, you have:

• Hands-on experience with NONMEM and R applied to population PK/PD model development, simulation, and model-informed drug development

• Strong programming skills and technical expertise to organize, perform, document, and report pharmacometric analyses to submission standard

• Experience with translational and clinical-stage analyses, including population PK, PK/PD, exposure-response, dose selection, and trial-design questions

Additional experience that would be an advantage:

• Industrial experience supporting regulatory interactions or submissions, including knowledge of relevant FDA, EMA, and ICH expectations for pharmacometric analyses

• Familiarity with LaTeX, Git and reproducible reporting workflows, or experience applying machine learning, artificial intelligence, or automation to pharmacometric workflows

Key competencies:

• You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude

• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key

• You communicate complex quantitative findings clearly, work effectively across disciplines, and balance analytical detail with broader development objectives

• You combine a strong quantitative background with biological and clinical understanding and collaborate effectively with scientists, clinicians, regulatory colleagues, and external partners. Your ability to share knowledge and contribute to common goals will be valued among colleagues

• Experience building and leading multinational, distributed teams and developing strong leaders.

• Platform modernisation, legacy consolidation and M&A integration experience.

• Hands-on understanding of where AI creates real customer and business value.

**Market Director Health and Public Institutions – Buildings & Industry

**__**Lyngby or Aarhus, Odense or Vejle

**_

_**Do you want to help shape some of Denmark's and the Nordic region's most important healthcare, education and public building projects? Can you build trusted relationships with key clients, grow business opportunities, and lead complex pursuits in a market with significant societal impact? And do you combine solid commercial acumen with deep insight into the health and public institutions sector? Then join COWI as our new Market Director for Health & Public Institutions within Buildings & Industry and apply your knowledge and curiosity to enable a better tomorrow.

**_

_**Shape the future of healthcare and public buildings

**_To strengthen COWI’s customer-centric approach, we are looking for a Market Director to drive business development and coordinate sales efforts within Health & Public Institutions in our Buildings & Industry sector.

This is a key role in one of COWI’s strategic growth markets, covering healthcare, education, research, cultural facilities and public development projects across Denmark and the Nordics. You will help position COWI on major hospital developments, universities, public institutions, refurbishment programmes and other complex projects that contribute to the development of society.

What makes this role unique is its pure focus on market leadership, where success is defined by customer value, business growth, and a strong market presence. Working closely with specialists, project managers and technical experts, you will build relationships, identify opportunities and grow COWI’s presence in the market. You will also become part of an experienced business development community that shares best practices and drives commercial excellence across COWI.

As part of a team of 25 experienced market professionals across COWI and Arkitema, you will work at the forefront of our business development efforts. Reporting to the Senior Market Director, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization to deepen client relationships, unlock strategic opportunities, and lead pursuits from early engagement through to project win, contributing directly to the continued growth of our business.

With increasing investments in healthcare, public buildings and sustainable transformation, the market offers significant growth potential. Your sector insight, commercial mindset and customer understanding will help position COWI as a preferred partner for public clients and healthcare organisations across the Nordic region.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Grow business development and growth across the Health & Public Institutions market segment by identifying, prioritizing, and converting strategic opportunities.

• Build and maintain close relationships with key customers, partners, and decisionmakers, acting as a trusted advisor and Key Account Manager for selected clients.

• Develop and manage a healthy sales pipeline, manage Go/No-Go decisions, and drive capture planning for major pursuits and tenders.

Lead and support complex proposal processes, ensuring compelling value propositions and effective collaboration across disciplines and business units.

• Provide direction and coordination for the Business Development team supporting the market segment, ensuring effective collaboration and delivery of market priorities.

• Monitor market trends, upcoming investments, and customer needs to help shape market strategies and long-term growth initiatives.

• Represent COWI externally through customer meetings, industry networks, conferences, and strategic partnerships.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**Like us, you believe that successful business development is built on trust, collaboration and long-term relationships. You are motivated by creating opportunities, understanding customer needs and bringing together the best teams to deliver value for clients and society. You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with fellow Market Directors and multidisciplinary teams to achieve shared goals.

To perform well in this role, it is essential that you bring solid market insight and a well-established network within healthcare, public institutions or the built environment sector. Equally important is your ability to build internal alliances and leverage the collective expertise of the organisation rather than acting alone.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background such as engineering, architecture, business or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in business development, client management, or market leadership within healthcare, public institutions, architecture, construction, or engineering consultancy.

• Deep knowledge of public-sector customers, procurement processes, and market dynamics, combined with a well-established professional network.

• Demonstrated skill in building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and converting opportunities into long-term partnerships.

• Experience contributing to large and complex tenders, proposals, and commercial negotiations.

• Demonstrated ability to provide leadership, direction, and coordination across Business Development teams, account managers, and framework agreement holders, ensuring a shared focus on market growth and client development without formal personnel responsibility.

• Solid communication and stakeholder management skills, with professional proficiency in both Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability and strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and collaboration – because that is what brings out the best in you, both at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people bringing expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Market Director Mikael Voldborg, Buildings & Industry, at mivo@cowi.com, or Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Janne Nielsen, at jane@cowi.com.

Get to know us better on our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we aim to achieve, and what it is like to be part of COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or cover letter required. Please add a short motivation for the role (4–5 lines) at the top of your CV. When it comes to photos, we prefer to form our first impression face to face rather than from a picture. If relevant, please also attach your portfolio.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI – inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair working environment where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities to thrive and develop. Our leaders act as role models for inclusive leadership and contribute to a culture where diverse perspectives and professional approaches are seen as a strength. We integrate diversity and inclusion into relevant decisions and processes, and when forming teams across architecture and engineering disciplines. We do this because it is part of our values – and simply because it is the right thing to do.

**About 3Shape

**Things have moved fast at 3Shape ever since our founding in 2000. 3Shape specializes in developing 3D scanning and software technology solutions that enable dental and hearing professionals to treat more people more effectively, and with improved care. Every second of every day, a 3Shape scanner is used all around the globe. A number which is skyrocketing and cementing our position as technology and industry leader, Danish growth comet and unicorn company. We are a truly international workplace with 50+ nationalities and more than 2200 employees globally. We are headquartered in Denmark in the center of vibrant Copenhagen at Kongens Nytorv.

**About The 3Shape 2-Year Graduate Program

**3Shape’s two-year Graduate Program serves as a launchpad for a high-impact career. Graduates rotate through three different departments within the Technical Track, with the possibility of an international assignment. This program gives talented and motivated young professionals the chance to acquire new knowledge, expand their skillset, and gain valuable expertise from the very beginning. Graduates gain unique insights into the core of our business and play an essential role in our strategy to develop future leaders and specialists at 3Shape.

**Become Our Next Technical Graduate

**As a 3Shape Graduate, you will be a valued team member, tackle complex business challenges, and become part of an extensive network of professionals in a global organization. We offer a steep learning curve and expect a lot from you, but in return, you will have opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.

• Rotate through three departments (8 months each) working with e.g., UX/UI, Software Development, Computer Science, IT, Data, Discovery, Regulatory Affairs, Product Management, and Production and Supply Chain.

• Play an essential role in an international and innovative organization that is constantly evolving.

• Lead and contribute to real projects with measurable impact.

• Broaden your horizons by working as part of integrated teams across the globe and collaborating with people from diverse backgrounds.

• Join a well-established, social, and friendly community of current and former Graduates.

• Receive ongoing feedback, coaching, and support from rotation managers, a mentor, and a buddy.

**We Fuel Your Career With

**

• Comprehensive onboarding - including an offsite, teambuilding, and networking with the Senior Leadership Team.

• Regular meetings with your Graduate Manager focused on your development and well-being.

• Multiple training sessions (such as Case Challenge, People Module, Technical Training, etc.).

• A production visit to our site in Poland.

• Quarterly Graduate-community activities with Graduates from our two cohorts

**What Makes a 3Shape Graduate?

**You are about to complete or have just completed a master’s degree. You have achieved top academic results and are highly proficient in English. You are enthusiastic, focused, and eager to learn.

• An excellent collaborator with an empathetic approach and a global mindset.

• Versatile and adaptable.

• Thrives in an international environment.

• Motivated to take responsibility.

• Strong analytical thinker with solid problem-solving skills.

• Brings positive energy and is eager to apply knowledge and make an impact.

**What 3Shape Offers

**

• A vibrant, international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled colleagues - over 20 nationalities represented in our Denmark-based office.

• An attractive healthcare package

• Daily breakfast, Friday juices, and healthy lunches prepared by our private chefs.

• A good social work environment with many optional activities and clubs, from wine and beer tastings to board games, running, and paddle.

• Modern offices and R&D labs in downtown Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

**Application Process

**

• Application deadline: 15/12/2026

• Graduate Program start date: 01/09/2027

• To apply, click "Apply Now" and attach your CV, answer two screening questions, and submit your academic records. Only complete applications will be considered.

• Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis – please apply as soon as possible.

• After a successful application and initial video call screening, candidates will be invited to our headquarters in Copenhagen for an assessment center on Friday, January 29th.

• If you have questions about the position or process, contact people@3shape.com.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

**About Us

**3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday across the globe on LinkedIn.

Are you ready to take the next step in your M&A career and gain hands-on experience across the full deal lifecycle in an international company with ambitious growth plans?

We are looking for an M&A Associate, Corporate Development, to join KK Group and support the execution of our M&A strategy and broader strategic growth agenda. This is an opportunity to work across the full M&A process, from identifying and evaluating potential acquisition opportunities to transaction execution and post-acquisition integration.

You will work closely with key stakeholders across the organization, combining financial analysis with strategic and commercial insights to support important investment decisions.

The role offers early responsibility, broad exposure to M&A and close interaction with senior management within an international group backed by A.P. Møller Holding, where M&A is an important lever for future growth.

The position is based in Copenhagen and requires presence in our Copenhagen office three days per week.

Your role

As an M&A Associate in Corporate Development, your primary responsibility will be to support the development and execution of KK's M&A strategy.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Conduct financial analysis, financial modelling and company valuations to support M&A and other strategic investment decisions.

• Support the execution of M&A transactions, including due diligence, coordination of external advisors, transaction documentation and other deal-related activities.

• Screen and assess potential acquisition targets, including strategic fit, financial performance, valuation and key investment considerations.

• Prepare investment cases, including strategic rationale, financial returns, risks and value creation opportunities.

• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify potential acquisition targets and assess new markets and growth opportunities.

• Work closely with business divisions and relevant functions to assess commercial, financial and operational aspects of potential acquisitions.

• Support post-acquisition integration planning, including identification and assessment of potential synergies.

• Support broader corporate development and strategic initiatives across the Group.

Your profile

We expect you to have 2-4 years of relevant professional experience, preferably from investment banking, corporate M&A, private equity or Big 4 transaction services. Candidates with a background in strategy consulting and strong financial capabilities will also be considered.

In addition, we expect that you have:

• Strong financial and analytical skills, including experience with financial modelling, valuation and financial statement analysis.

• Experience with M&A transactions, financial due diligence or other transaction-related activities.

• A good commercial understanding and the ability to combine financial analysis with strategic considerations.

• Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to develop clear and well-structured decision material.

• A structured and detail-oriented approach, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within tight deadlines.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks and challenge assumptions when relevant.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate financial and strategic conclusions clearly.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across functions, countries and organizational levels.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

We value intellectual curiosity, sound judgement and a willingness to take responsibility. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change, and where you are expected to take initiative, challenge assumptions and contribute actively.

Ready to build your M&A experience, take responsibility early on and contribute to KK Group’s next phase of growth? We would love to hear from you.

JOIN US IN COPENHAGEN TO HUMANISE BRANDS, SPARK HAPPINESS AND ORCHESTRATE INTERNATIONAL CLIENT PARTNERSHIPS

The Role: Driving World-Class Brand Development

Everland is looking for a full-time, on-site International Client Director to join our Copenhagen office

and drive the Client Service role for some of our key international client collaborations.

Being part of our Clients Services team, you will have a key role in our client collaborations, working

alongside Strategy, Creative, and Realisation to ensure our partnerships are as operationally

seamless as they are ambitious and impactful.

Your Mission: To Be "On It"

Your success is measured by the health of the relationship and the excellence of the delivery. You are

a high-level orchestrator of complex work streams, with responsibilities including:

• Service Excellence & Responsiveness: Providing the responsiveness that our clients crave. You are the primary point of contact for the ongoing collaboration, soaking up everyday tasks and solving tactical challenges with pragmatic, "can-do" energy.

• Master of Project Management: You take absolute ownership of the project management fundamentals. You lead the full brand and design development lifecycle, from defining initial scopes and meticulous budgeting to resource planning and timeline precision. You are the guardian of the brief and process, ensuring nothing is left out or to chance.

• Driving & Shaping Partnerships: You manage the full spectrum of client needs. This ranges from leading extensive, long-term brand development programmes to flawlessly coordinating the day-to-day tasks that keep a global brand moving.

• Team Integration: Acting as the operational glue within our teams. You bridge the gap between the strategic intent, the creative vision, and the client’s operational reality, ensuring that every project is delivered on time, on budget, and beyond expectation.

• "Beyond the Brief": Acting as the operational "eyes and ears" with your clients. Because you are so close to the daily work, you identify opportunities to create value beyond the initial scope, proactively proposing ways we can help clients solve their next challenge.

Your Profile: ‘Pro’ with International Outlook and Scandinavian Heart

We are looking for a team player who balances a professional "Director-level" weight with a

flat-hierarchy, sleeves-up mindset.

• The Experience: 10+ years of relevant professional experience. This must include at least 5 years of agency-side experience managing international clients within the consumer goods / FMCG industry.

• The Operational Specialist: You are a project manager by trade and a problem-solver by nature. You have the seniority to sit at the table with senior client stakeholders, but you have never lost your love for the "basics" of a perfectly managed workflow.

• The Commercial Driver: Commercially astute and growth-oriented. You possess a deep curiosity about your clients' business realities, allowing you to shape strategic solutions that truly address their needs while proactively identifying and driving organic growth opportunities for Everland.

• The Mindset: Resilient, energetic, and proactive. You don’t just flag problems; you take ownership. You take pride in "owning the machine" and making complex projects feel effortless for the client.

• The Collaborator: You thrive in a flat organisation. You are an empathic and natural team player who values the collective win over individual ego and understands the "One Team" philosophy across our functions and offices.

• The International: Some client-related travel activity (mainly Europe) must be expected, and your professional English must be flawless as this will be the main language in your client communications. As you will be based in Copenhagen, mastering a Scandinavian language is a nice bonus, but by no means a necessity.

Why Everland?

You will have a central role in an agency where we value freedom, responsibility, and the "One Team"

mindset. You will join a culture that plays to win but never forgets to spark happiness and keep it

human. Here, you will have the space to leave your mark on some of the world’s most famous

consumer brands while helping shape the future of our international Client Service approach.

Practical Information

• How to apply: Apply via LinkedIn or email your application and CV to our Head of Client Services, Emilie Aagreen emaa@everlandagency.com

• Deadline: ASAP – we will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

• Start date: By agreement.

About Everland

We help Humanise Brands to shape culture and drive sustainable value. Based on our human-centric

approach, we help brands grow with Character and Charisma. In everything they do, and everywhere

they are. Our Scandinavian DNA defines our way of working: an inclusive, direct, and ego-free approach to collaboration — with each other, our clients, and other agency partners alike.

Everland is an international brand and design partner specialised in FMCG brand worlds. We deliver

end-to-end expertise across brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, design realisation, and brand

guardianship.

We are proudly independent, entrepreneurs at heart, and consider ourselves challengers on the

international agency scene. This allows us to stay nimble, focused, and deeply committed to the

brands we nurture.
